title: DMC3 HD PC Save Layout and Integrity — Wide Pass 31

records.title: Exact 0x4A30 PC save block layout
records.summary: The canonical DMC3 HD executable and the supplied real dmc3.sav confirm a 0x4A30-byte file containing one 0x134+4 header block, ten 0x3C+4 summary blocks beginning at 0x138, and ten 0x708+4 payload blocks beginning at 0x3B8. The file ends at 0x4A30; there is no standalone 0x28 pre-payload metadata region.

locations.note: Exact physical layout validated against all block boundaries.
Registration values: count 10, header 0x134, summary 0x3C, payload 0x708. Layout calculator at VA 0x14033DE90 computes 0x4A30.

records.title: Per-block four-byte one's-complement integrity trailer
records.summary: Every header, summary and payload data block is followed by {u16 statusOrPresence, u16 integrityWord}. The validator performs little-endian 16-bit one's-complement addition with end-around carry over data plus trailer; a valid block folds to 0xFFFF. All 21 blocks in the supplied save validate.

locations.note: Validator at VA 0x14033BB50. Generation-equivalent formula: integrityWord = ~(folded_sum(data) + statusOrPresence).
First of 21 independently validated trailers. Summary and payload trailers follow each data block.

records.title: Summary calendar and save clock use packed BCD
records.summary: The summary fields at +0x01/+0x02/+0x03 and +0x24/+0x25/+0x26 are packed BCD. Playtime at +0x04/+0x05/+0x06 remains binary. This corrects the impossible plain-binary month interpretation from Pass 30.

locations.note: Builder at VA 0x14032B080 writes binary playtime and packed-BCD calendar/save-clock values.

records.title: Remaining save semantic frontier
records.summary: Physical layout and integrity are closed, but most header fields, summary fields +0x0C/+0x10/+0x14, semantic segmentation of the 0x708 payload, trailer status values beyond 0/1 and the exact integrity writer remain research required. These unknowns must not receive invented semantic names in editors or source recovery.

locations.note: Next canonical research scope is controlled differential saves and payload ownership mapping.
